title: Woods in Winter, Watercolor
content: Konstantin Kryzhitskywas one of the founders of the Society of Russian Watercolorists in 1880.Konstantin Kryzhitsky (1858-1911)Gathering Branches in Winter,signed in Cyrillic and dated 'K. Kryzhitsky 1903.'(watercolor and gouache on paper 13¾ x 18½ in. (34.9 x 47 cm.)In this forest landscape, he uses blobs of white gouache for the active shapes of the snow on evergreen fronds and for the distant sky holes. Most of the tree trunks however are handled with transparent paint.
